daily_note: Clips a day across every active campaign (the clips channel's own upload ceiling learns like the main one); each campaign gets a share by pay times its measured views (clips/insights.json), per_day each first, then up to per_day_max (8) each until the day's number is filled (series campaigns stay at per_day).
ceiling_note: The clips channel's own learning ceiling (clips/state/ceiling.json): from daily_clips, +clips_limit_step after each full day with no refusal, settles where YouTube refuses (uploadLimitExceeded). Campaigns switch off on their end date or when their public page says full, ended or under clips_budget_floor dollars left.
social_note: Every public clip is also posted as an Instagram Reel (IG_CLIPS_TOKEN, IG_CLIPS_USER_ID), a Facebook Reel (FB_CLIPS_PAGE_TOKEN, FB_CLIPS_PAGE_ID) and, when tiktok is true, on TikTok (tokens/tiktok_clips.enc), at the batch time, at most social_per_day a platform a day; each post gets its own row on the submit page because campaigns pay per platform. batch_times can give a platform its own time, e.g. {"Vyro": "22:00"}.
channels_note: Every active campaign lists its YouTube channels ("channels"): clips (the first channel, everything), gaming (Roblox, VALORANT, Call of Duty footage) and irl (creators and challenges: IShowSpeed, MrBeast). Each channel gets different moments of the same footage, its own daily number and ceiling (clips/state/ceiling_<name>.json), its own sign-in (tokens/youtube_<name>.enc from the social workflow) and its own IG_<NAME>_* and FB_<NAME>_* secrets. A channel without a sign-in is skipped until it has one. All channels live under the studio Google account.
